text: Make the per-hop discount of value flow explicit and tunable
description: Pouring 100% intrinsic each step and normalizing makes value = ½·intrinsic + ½·(passed on): an implicit 50% discount per hop (chain of 5 gives 0.5/0.25/0.125/0.063/0.063; splitting an idea into sub-ideas halves their value). It is also what keeps closed cycles finite. Proposal: same loop, but pour (1−d)·intrinsic and pass d·value, no normalization needed; d = 0.5 reproduces today exactly. A named constant (e.g. 0.8–0.9) keeps cycle support with a much milder depth bias. Later d could become a per-connection confidence derived from the hypothesis evaluation.
